items.title: How To Create Income From Arista Networks Stock
items.summary: Arista Networks (ANET) stock costs 63.2 times earnings, against 21.9 for the S&P 500. You can be paid now to agree to buy the shares at a much lower price. So how much income can you earn this way, and would you be glad to own Arista at that price.

items.title: Is Arista Networks Stock As Expensive As It Looks?
items.summary: Arista Networks (ANET) stock trades at 58.3 times its last twelve months of adjusted earnings, which add back stock-based pay after tax. That is a high price for one year of profit, and it is why the stock looks expensive. The picture changes against the profit forecast for this year and next. Here is that same share price, set against the profit Arista is forecast to earn in fiscal 2026 and fiscal 2027.

items.title: Does Analyst Optimism on AI-Fueled Optical Demand Change The Bull Case For Ciena (CIEN)?
items.summary: Ciena Corporation recently held a special call where analysts highlighted its strong positioning in optical networking as artificial intelligence infrastructure expands across global data centers. Analyst upgrades and upward earnings estimate revisions point to growing confidence that Ciena can capture rising demand for high-bandwidth AI connectivity. Next, we’ll examine how this AI-driven demand for optical networking could reshape Ciena’s investment narrative and future growth...
